name: Counter-Strike 2
description: Counter-Strike 2 dedicated server (Steam app 730, native Linux, anonymous login). Port 27015 carries the game (UDP) and RCON (TCP) and is advertised to Steam, so it is mirrored. A Game Server Login Token (GSLT) is strongly recommended. The install is the full 55-60 GB game depot and the first start takes a long time. Not covered: Workshop maps (they need a Steam Web API key via -authkey and +host_workshop_map; duplicate this definition to add them) and SourceTV.

variables.label: Server name
variables.description: Name shown in the server browser (hostname convar).

variables.label: Server password
variables.description: Password players need to join (sv_password). Leave empty for a public server.

variables.label: RCON password
variables.description: Remote console password (rcon_password), also needed by external admin tools. Leave empty to have one generated when the server is created (20 characters); managers can read and regenerate it in Settings.

variables.label: Game Server Login Token (GSLT)
variables.description: Steam game server login token, 32 hexadecimal characters, created at https://steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers for app 730. Optional but strongly recommended: without it the server may run as an anonymous, unlisted or restricted server.

variables.label: Starting map
variables.description: Map the server starts on (for example de_dust2, de_mirage, de_inferno, cs_office). The map must exist on the server.

variables.label: Game type
variables.description: game_type: 0 = Classic, 1 = Gun Game. Together with Game mode this selects the mode: Classic 0 = Casual, 1 = Competitive, 2 = Wingman; Gun Game 0 = Arms Race, 1 = Demolition, 2 = Deathmatch.

variables.label: Game mode
variables.description: game_mode (0, 1 or 2); the meaning depends on Game type, see its description.

variables.label: Disable VAC (insecure)
variables.description: Start with -insecure so Valve Anti-Cheat is off. Insecure servers are not shown to VAC-protected clients by default.
